items.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Unveiled Two New Security Services
items.summary: Fortinet (NasdaqGS:FTNT) has introduced the FortiGuard Inline AI Security Service and FortiLink SASE Service to broaden its security portfolio. The FortiGuard Inline AI Security Service provides AI-specific inspection and guardrails for enterprises adopting generative AI tools and workflows. FortiLink SASE Service offers agentless, cloud-delivered security for distributed locations that do not deploy on site firewalls.
